\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % incoming particle
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fline] (-1.6,0)--(-0.35,0); \draw[blob] (0,0) circle (0.35);
    \draw[fdmom] (-1.45,0.25)--(-0.75,0.25); \node[fdlab,above] at (-1.1,0.25) {$p$};
    \node[anchor=west] at (0.45,0) {$=u^{s}(p)$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-0.85) {incoming particle\\[1pt] $\hat\psi^+\vert\mathbf p,s\rangle$};
  \end{scope}
  % incoming antiparticle
  \begin{scope}[xshift=4.3cm]
    \draw[fline] (-0.35,0)--(-1.6,0); \draw[blob] (0,0) circle (0.35);
    \draw[fdmom] (-1.45,0.25)--(-0.75,0.25); \node[fdlab,above] at (-1.1,0.25) {$p$};
    \node[anchor=west] at (0.45,0) {$=\bar v^{s}(p)$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-0.85) {incoming antiparticle\\[1pt] $\hat{\bar\psi}^+\vert\mathbf p,s\rangle^c$};
  \end{scope}
  % outgoing particle
  \begin{scope}[xshift=9.0cm]
    \draw[blob] (0,0) circle (0.35); \draw[fline] (0.35,0)--(1.6,0);
    \draw[fdmom] (0.75,0.25)--(1.45,0.25); \node[fdlab,above] at (1.1,0.25) {$p$};
    \node[anchor=east] at (-0.45,0) {$\bar u^{s}(p)=$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-0.85) {outgoing particle\\[1pt] $\langle\mathbf p,s\vert\hat{\bar\psi}^-$};
  \end{scope}
  % outgoing antiparticle
  \begin{scope}[xshift=13.5cm]
    \draw[blob] (0,0) circle (0.35); \draw[fline] (1.6,0)--(0.35,0);
    \draw[fdmom] (0.75,0.25)--(1.45,0.25); \node[fdlab,above] at (1.1,0.25) {$p$};
    \node[anchor=east] at (-0.45,0) {$v^{s}(p)=$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-0.85) {outgoing antiparticle\\[1pt] ${}^c\langle\mathbf p,s\vert\hat\psi^-$};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
